meta.name: domain-modeling
meta.description: Build the project's shared language and bounded contexts before writing code, so names stay consistent and the agent stops paraphrasing domain concepts. Produces a CONTEXT.md glossary and decision records. Use at the start of a project or feature, or when the codebase and the people describing it speak different languages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 建立项目统一语言和限界上下文，产出术语表和决策记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队对领域概念理解不一致，或代码与业务语言脱节
copy.tagline_en: Establish shared language and bounded contexts for your project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team has inconsistent domain understanding or code diverges from business language

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在写代码前先整理项目术语，生成一份术语表（CONTEXT.md）和决策记录，确保术语一致，不再用多个词描述同一个概念。
howto.when: 在项目或功能开始时，或当代码库与人们描述的语言不一致时触发。

say.text: 帮我梳理这个项目的核心术语，生成 CONTEXT.md。
say.note: Claude 会提取术语并定义。

say.text: 这个模块的“订单”和“工单”有什么区别？
say.note: Claude 会分析并记录边界。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude organizes project terms before writing code, producing a CONTEXT.md glossary and decision records to keep names consistent and avoid paraphrasing domain concepts.
howto.when_en: Triggered at the start of a project or feature, or when the codebase and the people describing it speak different languages.

say_en.text: Help me extract the core terms for this project and generate CONTEXT.md.
say_en.note: Claude will harvest terms and define them.

say_en.text: What is the difference between 'order' and 'ticket' in this module?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and record boundaries.
